title: MediaServer Overview
description: Complete overview of NoMercy MediaServer features and capabilities
content:
# NoMercy MediaServer

## Overview

NoMercy MediaServer is a comprehensive solution for managing and streaming your media collection.

## Features

- **Centralized Management**: Organize all your media in one place
- **Streaming**: Stream media to any device
- **Search**: Powerful search with semantic understanding
- **Organization**: Automatic tagging and categorization

## Getting Started

Head to the [configuration guide](./configuration.md) to set up your media server.
author: NoMercy Team

title: MediaServer Configuration
description: Configure NoMercy MediaServer for your environment
content:
# MediaServer Configuration

## Basic Configuration

Configure the fundamental settings of your MediaServer:

### Database Setup

Set up your database connection for storing media metadata.

### Library Paths

Add directories containing your media files:

- Movies
- TV Shows
- Music
- Documents

### Server Settings

Configure server port, logging level, and other runtime options.

## Advanced Configuration

For advanced users, additional configuration options are available in the config file.

title: Installation Guide
description: Step-by-step installation instructions for NoMercy apps
content:
# Installation Guide

This guide will walk you through the installation process for NoMercy applications.

## System Requirements

- Windows 10 or later
- 4GB RAM minimum
- 100MB disk space

## Installation Steps

1. Download the latest installer from our releases page
2. Run the installer
3. Follow the setup wizard
4. Launch the application

## Troubleshooting

If you encounter any issues during installation, please check our FAQ or contact support.
